steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: An index number measures how a quantity changes relative to a base period; the base value is always 100 | Key Fact: Index number = (current value ÷ base value) × 100; an index of 120 means a 20% increase from the base period | Key Fact: RPI (Retail Prices Index) measures the change in cost of a basket of goods and services including mortgage interest payments | Key Fact: CPI (Consumer Prices Index) is similar to RPI but excludes mortgage interest and housing costs; CPI is used for the government’s inflation target
